minutes.headline: Select Board chose four FY24 state earmark priorities and reviewed senior tax relief and town meeting articles.
minutes.summary: The board opened with a member's resignation letter, then took public comment, two toll booth requests, committee and registrar appointments, and ratified a recreation director. It narrowed its legislative earmark requests to four, discussed the senior tax relief home rule petition against town counsel's comments, and gave recommendations on many annual town meeting articles, deferring those without numbers. A member raised doubts about when tax bills were actually mailed.

what_happened.line: The Select Board narrowed its FY24 state legislative earmark requests to four: Turkey Hill/primary school security, Marshall Park, library exterior painting and a sewer pump station.
The board discussed the senior tax relief warrant article against town counsel's comments; the town manager will ask counsel about section six and bring a revision next week.
The board gave recommendations on several annual town meeting articles and deferred the overlay article by a week; revolving fund limits were unchanged from the prior year.
The board approved two toll booth requests, appointed 300th anniversary committee members and a registrar, ratified a recreation director, and approved a common victualler license.
A member raised doubts about when tax bills were actually mailed, and the concern was referred to the town manager.

why_it_matters: The earmark list sets which town projects the board will ask the state to fund, which affects what the town may have to pay for itself through taxes.
The senior tax relief article and the overlay article are both warrant items residents will be asked to vote on at annual town meeting, and the senior relief wording is still being revised.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board agenda: the revised senior tax relief article, the deferred overlay recommendation and the deferred public safety security upgrades.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary:
The two records agree on the main appointments, the skate park tollbooth, the common victualler license and most dollar figures. They differ on the Shriners tollbooth vote, the Recreation Director vote, the revolving fund and overlay figures, the four ATM recommendation votes only the town records, and who was on the board.
A reader should check the Shriners vote, the Clement ratification and the attendee list against the recording. Those are the places where the captions may have invented, or the town's minutes may have dropped, something substantive.
